title: Our store must win in a shrinking PC market and in AI-led shopping
summary: Asus expects the 2027 PC market to shrink 10-15% on memory prices; tablet shipments fell 23% in Q3 (Omdia). OpenAI launched ChatGPT Wallet and Amazon took Alexa for Shopping to 15 countries. Amex sees small-business holiday spending at a 14-year high.

points.headline: Memory costs are shrinking the PC and tablet market into 2027
points.detail: Asus expects the 2027 PC market down 10-15%, notebook shipments stay weak through Q2 2027 and tablets fell 23% in Q3. We should plan promo depth, inventory and financing for a smaller, pricier market.

points.headline: AI agents can now pay at retailer checkouts, so our store must be agent-ready
points.detail: OpenAI's ChatGPT Wallet lets Pro users buy through the Dots agent, and Amazon extended Alexa for Shopping to 15 countries. We should check catalog data and checkout work for agent-initiated orders.

points.headline: Marketplaces are consolidating discovery, from Amazon to JD.com in Europe
points.detail: Amazon plans to catalog every product online, even unstocked items, and JD.com seeks to lead European electronics retail via Ceconomy. We should secure listing accuracy and watch channel terms.

points.headline: Small businesses and early, price-aware holiday shoppers are the demand to chase
points.detail: Amex projects a 14-year high in small-business holiday spending, and research shows shoppers start earlier and weigh affordability. We should push business bundles, financing and earlier offers.
